text:
Shopflow (customer): Hey team — since last night's model rollout our /summarize endpoint started prepending a short preface like 'As an AI assistant...' to every customer-facing summary. This is breaking our UI and we didn't change our prompt. Can you help?

Sanjay (CS): Sorry about that — can you paste a couple of offending outputs and the original input you sent? Also any request IDs if you have them.

Shopflow (customer): Example 1:
Input: "Order #5732 items: 2x red socks, 1x blue hat. Summarize items for packing slip."
Output: "As an AI assistant, I'm happy to help. Order summary: 2x red socks, 1x blue hat."

Example 2:
Input: "Customer asked: what items are in order 8931?"
Output: "I can't browse external systems, but as an AI assistant here's what I can infer: order contains..."

Ava (CS): Thanks — that helps. Are you able to share the prompt logs (the exact messages sent to the model) or the request IDs? If you prefer, you can upload redacted logs here: https://redwood.support/upload/xxxx. Please remove any PII.

Shopflow (customer): Uploaded two request logs (IDs: rq_8a3f, rq_8a4b). Note we never add an assistant/system preface in our code.

Sanjay (CS): Got the logs, thanks. Diego, can you take a look? Looks like outputs include the new preface.

Diego (ML Eng): Looking now. Quick checklist: which model variant were you pinned to? Any custom system prompt or latest SDK? Also did you opt into 'safety_prose' or any postprocessing?

Shopflow (customer): We're pinned to model: redwood-embed-text-2025 (we think) via the SDK pinned at 3.1.0. No extra system prompt. No postprocessing on our side.

Lena (Platform): Deploy-bot shows a canary rollout for redwood-summarize-v2 at 2159872000 last night, then a full rollout at 2159875000. I can ring-fence traffic if needed.

Diego (ML Eng): From the prompt logs it looks like a lightweight system instruction was injected server-side for the new variant: "You may include an assistant preface when the user intent is ambiguous." That explains the preface. We need a minimal repro to confirm whether it's model behaviour or an injected prompt.

Diego (ML Eng): Can you run this minimal curl from your environment and paste the exact response? Replace YOUR_KEY and the model name you use:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-summarize-v2","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Summarize items for packing slip: 2x red socks, 1x blue hat."}],"temperature":0.0}'
```

Shopflow (customer): Ran it, response included the preface. Copied body into the support upload.

Ava (CS): Thanks — that strongly points to the model variant introducing a canned preface. Diego, can we confirm if the model weights or the serving config added that system message?

Diego (ML Eng): I'm seeing a short server-side system msg in the new variant manifest: "If task is ambiguous, add high-level assistant preface." I did not expect this for summarization. I'll open a rollback/patch.

deploy-bot: Canary rollback scheduled for redwood-summarize-v2 -> rolling back canary to previous variant at 2159876700 :gear:

Lena (Platform): Rolling back canary now. If Shopflow wants immediate mitigation we can route their workspace to the previous variant (temporary pin). Would you like us to do that?

Shopflow (customer): Yes please, pin us back to the previous variant. That will unblock our UI for now.

Sanjay (CS): Action items for Shopflow: 1) We'll pin you back to previous variant and confirm when done. 2) Diego will remove the injected system preface rule from the summarization manifest. 3) Please keep the uploaded logs for a few days in case we need more traces.

Diego (ML Eng): Also recommended: run a quick batch of 10 deterministic tests (temperature 0.0) using the curl above across a handful of sample inputs and attach the outputs here. That helps us rule out stochastic drift vs rule injection.

Shopflow (customer): Will run the 10 tests and share results. Appreciate the speedy help :thumbsup:

Sanjay (CS): Closing the escalation from a customer-visible POV once pin is applied. We'll keep this thread for the follow-ups and postmortem notes.

Lena (Platform): Pin applied for Shopflow workspace -> variant redwood-summarize-v1 (rollback confirmed).

Shopflow (customer): Confirmed — UI looks correct now, preface gone. Thank you.

Diego (ML Eng): Follow-up: I'll remove the system rule from the manifest and push a corrected rollout. ETA 4 hours. I'll post the manifest diff here when done.

Sanjay (CS): Thanks team. Leaving thread open until manifest change is deployed and Shopflow runs their batch checks.

Shopflow (customer): Posted the 10 deterministic test outputs to the upload link. All good after the pin.

Diego (ML Eng): Received. I pushed the manifest change at 2159876600 and started a small canary. Monitoring for any preface occurrences.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy for redwood-summarize-v2 (manifest v2.1 -> v2.1.1) started at 2159876620

Diego (ML Eng): Preliminary canary checks (n=50) show no prefacing behavior. Will let canary run and then roll to full if stable.

Sanjay (CS): Marking as resolved for customer. If the preface reappears, please re-open and include one of the failing request IDs. :white_check_mark:

Shopflow (customer): Will do. Thanks again! :raised_hands:
